summary: With an explicit fixture cwd on both initial and resumed commands, the same real Codex conversation passed CAP-001 and CAP-002. Native exec dispatched two reading tools through Promise.all, returned both actual values, applied a native patch and read back ALPHA-BETA. Exactly one 15-second timer yielded a running cell; wait resumed that same cell and returned WAIT-110-OK, then a real patch and command verified the file. Both actual contexts retained GPT-6 Sol/medium, workspace-write, on-request and auto_review. All observed file-change events remained inside the owned fixture.
